description: Verified Gurugram department directory used to seed a fresh public UIMRS database.
source: Documented verified-directory rows in uimrs_india_dev.db, read read-only during Task 15 preparation.
source_note: Bengaluru historical agencies are deliberately excluded from the public deployment.

departments.name: Municipal Corporation of Gurugram (MCG) - Drains & Sewerage
departments.jurisdiction: Municipal Corporation of Gurugram municipal area, Gurugram district, Haryana
departments.contact_purpose: MCG helpline for complaints; Chief Engineer office email. GMDA also publishes new sewerage/drainage connections, so ownership varies.

departments.name: Municipal Corporation of Gurugram (MCG) - Solid Waste Management & Sanitation
departments.jurisdiction: Municipal Corporation of Gurugram municipal area, Gurugram district, Haryana
departments.contact_purpose: MCG 24x7 toll-free municipal complaint helpline and official public email. General complaint channel, not a zone-specific escalation contact.

departments.name: Municipal Corporation of Gurugram (MCG) - Town Planning & Building Enforcement
departments.jurisdiction: Municipal Corporation of Gurugram municipal area, Gurugram district, Haryana
departments.contact_purpose: Chief Town Planner office line and official email for planning and building matters. GMDA also approves building plans in its area.

departments.name: Municipal Corporation of Gurugram (MCG) - Citizen Grievance Redressal
departments.jurisdiction: Municipal Corporation of Gurugram municipal area, Gurugram district, Haryana
departments.contact_purpose: MCG 24x7 toll-free helpline and official public email for general grievances. Disabled for automatic routing because 'Other' has no verified responsible authority.

departments.name: Municipal Corporation of Gurugram (MCG) - Public Property & Assets
departments.jurisdiction: Municipal Corporation of Gurugram municipal area, Gurugram district, Haryana
departments.contact_purpose: MCG helpline and official public email. Asset ownership is not verified per location, so no automatic assignment is made.

departments.name: Municipal Corporation of Gurugram (MCG) - Engineering & Roads
departments.jurisdiction: Municipal Corporation of Gurugram municipal area, Gurugram district, Haryana
departments.contact_purpose: MCG helpline for complaints; Chief Engineer office email. Road ownership varies, so no automatic assignment is made.

departments.name: Municipal Corporation of Gurugram (MCG) - Electrical & Street Lighting
departments.jurisdiction: Municipal Corporation of Gurugram municipal area, Gurugram district, Haryana
departments.contact_purpose: MCG helpline for complaints; Chief Engineer office email, under which the Electrical wing is listed in the official office directory.

departments.name: Gurugram Traffic Police - Traffic Management
departments.jurisdiction: Gurugram Police Commissionerate, Gurugram district, Haryana
departments.contact_purpose: DCP Traffic, Gurugram office line and official email for traffic-management complaints.

departments.name: Gurugram Metropolitan Development Authority (GMDA) - Traffic Signals
departments.jurisdiction: Gurugram Metropolitan Area; traffic-signal ownership varies by road, so no automatic assignment is made
departments.contact_purpose: GMDA Complaint Handling System toll-free helpline and official email; GMDA publishes a dedicated traffic-light complaint channel.

departments.name: Municipal Corporation of Gurugram (MCG) - Horticulture & Environment
departments.jurisdiction: Municipal Corporation of Gurugram municipal area, Gurugram district, Haryana
departments.contact_purpose: MCG helpline for complaints; Executive Engineer-VI (Horticulture & Engineering) office email.

departments.name: Gurugram Metropolitan Development Authority (GMDA) - Water Supply
departments.jurisdiction: Gurugram Metropolitan Area as defined under the GMDA Act, 2017; asset ownership varies by road and sector
departments.contact_purpose: GMDA Complaint Handling System toll-free helpline and official email.
